build_roi_box_head: build a ROIBoxHead instance from config and input channels for Faster R-CNN box head
create_roi_box_head_forward: create a forward pass through ROIBoxHead with features, proposals, and optional targets
review_roi_box_head_subsample: review the ROIBoxHead training subsample logic that filters proposals with positive negative ratio
test_roi_box_head_predictor: test the ROIBoxHead predictor to produce class logits and box regression outputs
summarize_roi_box_head_loss: summarize the ROIBoxHead loss evaluator that computes classifier and box regression losses
